column1: # Go files whose licence header may differ from the canonical two lines
# (`// Copyright <year> AxonFlow` + `// SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1`),
# read by tests/regression-test-required/go_licence_header_test.sh and by
# scripts/licence/normalise-go-headers.py through lib/go_licence_header.py.
# Three tab-separated columns: pattern, kind, reason. A pattern is an exact
# repo-relative path, a directory prefix ending in `/`, or a glob. Kinds:
#   spdx:<ID>   the file's single SPDX identifier is <ID>, and no other licence
#               text appears; a file that later declares BUSL-1.1 fails the row
#   generated   the file carries a `// Code generated` marker; the generator
#               owns its header
#   deferred    the files may LACK a header, or carry an incomplete one, for
#               the reason given; a second licence is never deferred; the row
#               FAILS once every matching file is canonical
#   escalated   non-canonical pending the ruling named in the reason; same
#               staleness rule as deferred
# Every row must match at least one file, so a row cannot outlive what it
# excuses. The reason column is not decoration: a row without one is refused.
platform/gateway-adapters/agentgateway/api/*.pb.go
column3: protoc output; the generator writes the header and a hand edit is lost on the next regeneration
